product_overview: Futbol Quiz is a Turkish-language football trivia backend built as JSON API route handlers for search, daily game modes, feedback, and limited account/leaderboard features. All core games are playable anonymously, while authentication is reserved for leaderboard, reporting, room, and account actions.
core_goals: Provide stable JSON APIs for football club and player search.
Support multiple trivia game modes with server-side validation and no answer leakage.
Enforce consistent Turkish error handling, rate limiting, and caching rules across every endpoint.
Allow Google OAuth-based account features, leaderboard reporting, and multiplayer rooms only for authenticated users.
Send feedback emails through a fixed server-side recipient while preventing relay abuse and identity spoofing.

features.name: Club search API
features.description: Lets users autocomplete and search clubs, optionally filtered by league Wikidata QID, without requiring login.
user_flows: GET /api/clubs?q=ars&limit=10&league=Q9458 -> Receive 200 with { data: Club[] } matching the search term and league filter
GET /api/clubs?q=ars&limit=0 -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with a Turkish message for invalid limit
GET /api/clubs?q=verylonginvalidsearchterm... -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR when the query exceeds the allowed length
GET /api/clubs?q=ars&league=ABC123 -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR because league must match /^Q[0-9]+$/
Burst many GET /api/clubs requests quickly -> Receive 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and no-store

features.name: Player search API
features.description: Lets users search players by required name term and optional stat/target filters, while avoiding exposure of club history.
user_flows: GET /api/players?q=lionel&limit=5&stat=goals -> Receive 200 with { data: PlayerSuggestion[] } for matching players
GET /api/players?limit=5 -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR because q is required
GET /api/players?q=lionel&limit=0 -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR for an out-of-range limit
GET /api/players?q=lionel&stat=unknown_stat -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR because stat must be a known stat key
GET /api/players?q=lionel&target=yes -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR because target must be the literal "true"
Burst many GET /api/players requests quickly -> Receive 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and no-store

features.name: Common Players game API
features.description: Finds players who have played for both selected clubs, with optional youth and loan inclusion flags and a rule preventing same-club selection.
user_flows: GET /api/common-players?clubA=club-1&clubB=club-2&includeYouth=true&includeLoans=false -> Receive 200 with { data: { players: [...] } } for the shared-player intersection
GET /api/common-players?clubA=club-1&clubB=club-1 -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR because selecting the same club is forbidden by the SAME_CLUB rule
GET /api/common-players?clubA=club-1 -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR because clubB is required
GET /api/common-players?clubA=club-1&clubB=club-2&includeYouth=maybe -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR because includeYouth must be exactly "true" or "false"
Burst many GET /api/common-players requests quickly -> Receive 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and no-store

features.name: Izgara (Grid) game API
features.description: Provides the daily 3x3 grid, available criteria for custom grids, and answer validation for both daily and custom modes.
user_flows: GET /api/grid -> Receive 200 with { data: { grid... } } containing 6 criteria labels and 9 empty cells
GET /api/grid/criteria -> Receive 200 with { data: Criteria[] } for building a custom grid
POST /api/grid/answer with valid JSON body {"row":1,"col":2,"playerId":"player-123"} -> Receive 200 with { data: { correct: boolean, ... } } using server-derived daily criteria
POST /api/grid/custom-answer with valid JSON body {"rowCriterion":{...},"colCriterion":{...},"playerId":"player-123"} -> Receive 200 with { data: { correct: boolean, ... } } for a user-built grid
POST /api/grid/answer with malformed JSON -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with the Turkish malformed-body message
POST /api/grid/custom-answer with invalid criteria or playerId -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
Burst many grid requests quickly -> Receive 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and no-store

features.name: Istatistik (Stat-match) game API
features.description: Serves daily stat-round metadata and scores player picks server-side without exposing the target value to the client.
user_flows: GET /api/stat-match -> Receive 200 with { data: { round... } } for the daily stat round
GET /api/stat-match/target -> Receive 200 with { data: { target... } } for the "Sen seç" sub-round metadata
POST /api/stat-match/answer with valid JSON body {"statKey":"goals","playerId":"player-123"} -> Receive 200 with { data: { score, trueValue, ... } } computed by the server
POST /api/stat-match/answer with valid JSON body {"statKey":"goals","playerId":"player-123","targetId":"player-456"} -> Receive 200 with a scored result for the optional target-based mode
POST /api/stat-match/answer with malformed JSON -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
POST /api/stat-match/answer with unknown statKey or invalid identifier -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
Burst many stat-match requests quickly -> Receive 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and no-store

features.name: Hangisi Daha (Which More) game API
features.description: Returns comparison rounds with two players and a stat label, then reveals both values only after the user submits an answer.
user_flows: GET /api/hangisi-daha/round -> Receive 200 with { data: { round... } } containing two players and a stat label but no numeric values
POST /api/hangisi-daha/answer with valid JSON body describing the round choice -> Receive 200 with { data: { correct: boolean, values... } } revealing both values after submission
POST /api/hangisi-daha/answer with malformed JSON -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
POST /api/hangisi-daha/answer with invalid fields or missing choice -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
Burst many hangisi-daha requests quickly -> Receive 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and no-store

features.name: Geri Bildirim (Feedback) API
features.description: Sends a suggestion or complaint email using a server-fixed recipient and user-provided reply-to email and message.
user_flows: POST /api/geri-bildirim with valid JSON body {"email":"user@example.com","message":"Bu bir geri bildirim mesajıdır."} -> Receive 200 with { data: { sent: true } } when the mailer is available
POST /api/geri-bildirim with malformed JSON -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with the Turkish malformed-body message
POST /api/geri-bildirim with invalid email or a message shorter than 10 characters -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
POST /api/geri-bildirim with an overlong message -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
POST /api/geri-bildirim in this environment with a valid request and placeholder RESEND_API_KEY -> Receive 500 INTERNAL_ERROR from the mail provider rejecting/unreachable state
Burst many feedback requests quickly -> Receive 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and no-store

features.name: Lider Tablosu (Leaderboard) reporting API
features.description: Allows logged-in users to report a displayed leaderboard name using a fixed reason list, while preventing self-reporting and name spoofing.
user_flows: POST /api/lider-tablosu/bildir without a session cookie -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR with "Bildirmek için giriş yapmalısın."
POST /api/lider-tablosu/bildir with valid session and body {"reportedName":"SomeName","reason":"spam"} -> Receive 200 with { data: { reported: true } }
POST /api/lider-tablosu/bildir with malformed JSON -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
POST /api/lider-tablosu/bildir with an invalid reason not in the fixed list -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
POST /api/lider-tablosu/bildir with own display name -> Receive 400 VALIDATION_ERROR
Burst many report requests quickly -> Receive 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and no-store

features.name: Authentication API (Google OAuth)
features.description: Supports Google-only authentication, session creation, registration of a display name, logout, and account deletion; the full OAuth flow is not scriptable end-to-end.
user_flows: GET /api/auth/google -> Receive a redirect response that begins Google OAuth login
GET /api/auth/callback/google after Google redirects back -> Receive session establishment and a successful login state
POST /api/auth/kayit with a valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 with the registration result for the chosen display name
POST /api/auth/cikis -> Receive 200 and clear the session cookie
POST /api/auth/hesap-sil with a valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 and delete the account and all scores
POST /api/auth/kayit without a session -> Receive an auth-gated failure response as enforced by the server
Burst many auth requests quickly -> Receive 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and no-store

features.name: Oda (Multiplayer Rooms) API
features.description: Lets two logged-in users create, join, inspect, and answer in multiplayer rooms by code.
user_flows: POST /api/oda with a valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 with a new room code and room state
GET /api/oda/{kod} with a valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 with the room lobby/state for that code
POST /api/oda/{kod}/katil with a valid authenticated session -> Receive 200 and join the room by code
POST /api/oda/{kod}/cevap with a valid authenticated session and answer payload -> Receive 200 with the room round answer result
POST /api/oda with no session cookie -> Receive an auth-gated failure because rooms require login
Burst many room requests quickly -> Receive 429 RATE_LIMITED with Retry-After and no-store

security_notes: Error bodies never leak stack traces, SQL, or file paths (only the 4 codes above + a generic message + traceId).
Rate limiting is applied for EVERY endpoint BEFORE any work; a 429 returns Retry-After and is never cached (Cache-Control no-store).
Identity is always read server-side from the session cookie, never from the request body; a client cannot act as another user.
Malformed JSON body returns 400 VALIDATION_ERROR ("Gövde geçerli JSON olmalıdır."), never 500.
Answer/mutation endpoints send Cache-Control no-store; public read endpoints send public, s-maxage.

features.name: Club search API
features.description: Autocomplete/search over clubs, with optional league (Wikidata QID) filter. Read-only, no auth.

endpoints.description: Search clubs by term; optional limit and league (Wikidata QID) filter.

response_schema.400: VALIDATION_ERROR when limit out of range, league not a Q-id, or q too long

features.name: Player search API
features.description: Search players by name (required term); optional filters for stat-scoreable and target-eligible players. Read-only, no auth. Response never carries a player's club history (would leak the answer key).

endpoints.description: Search players by required term q; optional limit, stat (valid stat key), target ("true").

query.stat: string (optional, must be a known stat key)

response_schema.400: VALIDATION_ERROR when q missing/too long, limit out of range, or stat/target invalid

features.name: Common Players game API
features.description: Core mode — players who played for BOTH of two clubs. Same-club selection is a domain rule violation (SAME_CLUB -> 400). Read-only, no auth.

endpoints.description: List players shared by clubA and clubB; optional includeYouth/includeLoans strict "true"/"false".

response_schema.400: VALIDATION_ERROR when clubA/clubB missing, include flags not "true"/"false", or same club (SAME_CLUB rule, BR-4)

features.name: Izgara (Grid) game API
features.description: 3x3 grid. Daily grid and its criteria are read endpoints; answers are POSTs. Server regenerates the grid from a seed and never trusts client-supplied criteria on the daily answer path. Custom grids accept criteria in the body on a separate endpoint. No auth.

endpoints.description: Daily 3x3 grid with 6 criteria labels and 9 empty cells (no answers).
Available grid criteria (for building a custom grid).
Validate a player answer for a daily-grid cell. Body carries only cell coordinate + playerId; criteria are re-derived server-side.

response_schema.400: VALIDATION_ERROR on malformed JSON or missing/invalid fields

endpoints.description: Validate a player answer for a user-built grid whose criteria come from the body.

response_schema.400: VALIDATION_ERROR on malformed JSON or invalid criteria/player

features.name: Istatistik (Stat-match) game API
features.description: Daily statistic mode. Read endpoints give the daily round and the "Sen seç" target; the answer POST scores a pick. The server computes the score; the client never sends the target value. Works anonymously; a logged-in user's completed round is recorded to the leaderboard.

endpoints.description: Daily stat round (target stats, no answer values leaked).
Target player metadata for the "Sen seç" sub-round.
Score a stat pick. Body has statKey + playerId (+ optional targetId for "Sen seç"). Server computes the score.

body.statKey: string (must be a known stat key)

response_schema.400: VALIDATION_ERROR on malformed JSON, unknown stat, or invalid identifier

features.name: Hangisi Daha (Which More) game API
features.description: Comparison rounds. The round endpoint returns two players WITHOUT their stat values; the answer POST returns both values so the client cannot solve the game locally. No auth.

endpoints.description: A comparison round — two players and a statistic label, no numeric values.
Submit the chosen player; response reveals both values and correctness.

response_schema.400: VALIDATION_ERROR on malformed JSON or invalid fields

features.name: Geri Bildirim (Feedback) API
features.description: Send a suggestion/complaint email via Resend. Recipient is fixed server-side (CONTACT_EMAIL); the body only carries reply-to email + message. Feature is gated on RESEND_API_KEY. No auth.

endpoints.description: Email feedback. Recipient hardcoded server-side; client cannot choose it (SSRF/open-relay guard).

response_schema.400: VALIDATION_ERROR on malformed JSON, invalid email, message length out of range, or feature disabled (mailer null)
response_schema.500: INTERNAL_ERROR when the mail provider is unreachable/rejects (expected in this env: RESEND_API_KEY is a placeholder)

depends_on: Resend HTTPS API (api.resend.com) — only outbound host added for this feature (PROJECT.md §7.4)

features.name: Lider Tablosu (Leaderboard) reporting API
features.description: Report a displayed leaderboard name from a FIXED reason list (no free text). Login required; identity read server-side. Reporting your own name is rejected.

endpoints.description: Report a display name with a fixed-list reason. Requires a logged-in session.

body.reason: enum (one of REPORT_REASONS, no free text)

response_schema.400: VALIDATION_ERROR when not logged in ("Bildirmek için giriş yapmalısın."), malformed JSON, invalid reason, self-report, or unknown name

features.name: Authentication API (Google OAuth)
features.description: Google OAuth only — no username/password. Start + callback are GETs; registration/logout/account-deletion are POSTs. Cannot be automated end-to-end (no scriptable OAuth).

endpoints.description: Begin Google OAuth (redirect to Google).
OAuth callback; establishes the session.
Set the chosen display name after first login.
Log out (clear session).
Delete the account and all scores.

features.name: Oda (Multiplayer Rooms) API
features.description: Two logged-in users create/join a room by code and answer rounds. All endpoints require login.

endpoints.description: Create a room.
Room lobby/state by code.
Join a room by code.
Submit a round answer in a room.

known_limitations.issue: Authenticated endpoints cannot be automated. Login is Google OAuth only; there is no username/password or token endpoint to script.
known_limitations.impact: Rooms, account registration/deletion, and leaderboard name-reporting cannot be exercised past their auth gate. The correct GUEST behavior (bildir returns 400 "Bildirmek için giriş yapmalısın.") IS testable.

known_limitations.issue: Feedback email cannot actually send in this environment because RESEND_API_KEY is a placeholder value.
known_limitations.impact: A valid POST /api/geri-bildirim returns HTTP 500 INTERNAL_ERROR (provider unreachable/rejects). This is an ENVIRONMENT limitation, not a defect. The 400 validation paths (bad email, short/long message, malformed JSON) are fully testable and expected.

known_limitations.issue: Rate limiting is global and applied before every request.
known_limitations.impact: A test that fires many requests quickly may receive 429 RATE_LIMITED (with Retry-After). This is correct behavior; back off or space requests. Do NOT treat a 429 as a functional failure.

known_limitations.issue: The football dataset (clubs/players) is a fixed read-only SQLite database.
known_limitations.impact: Club/player identifiers must be discovered via the search endpoints (/api/clubs, /api/players); do not assume arbitrary ids exist.
